scripts.generate:content-runtime: rm -rf .content-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.content.json && node scripts/generate-mobile-curriculum.cjs && node scripts/generate-runtime-content.cjs && rm -rf .content-dist
scripts.build: npm run generate:content-runtime && next build && npm run check:bundle-boundaries
scripts.build:android-apk: npm run generate:content-runtime && cd word_trail_flutter && flutter build apk --release --target-platform android-arm,android-arm64 && cd .. && node scripts/check-android-apk.cjs word_trail_flutter/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
scripts.test: npm run generate:content-runtime && rm -rf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/tests/*.test.js
